Introduction

Queenz Eye is a South Korean girl group under Big Mountain Entertainment. They originally debuted as a six-member group on October 24, 2022, with the release of their first single album, 'Queenz Table'.

The group underwent lineup changes with Jenna departing in April 2023 and Hannah, Na Rin, and Da Min in January 2025. The addition of new members was announced in July 2025.
